non_claims: Enabled settings are repository configuration; they do not establish that a report will be handled or that no secret exists in history
The ruleset is projection configuration; it is not Radicle governance and does not protect canonical main
A row in the organization profile is a link; it does not publish the launch preparation
Changing visibility cannot retract copies that were already fetched
Launch documents are copy and procedure, not evidence of release readiness; onix_release_ready is false
Test and coverage figures describe one host and one unpublished tree; they do not validate a tagged revision
